mode: Behavioral scenarios; expected outcomes are rubrics, not executed MCP results

evals.prompt: When a lead enters Qualified, start the nurture Cadence.
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves real stage/Cadence IDs, validates trigger/action schema, checks existing overlap and routing, simulates matching/non-matching leads, applies safely and verifies activation separately.

evals.prompt: Create a Workflow that forces any interested lead to Qualified.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects bypassing the qualification contract and routes qualification criteria to the qualification skill.

evals.prompt: Two Workflows both send a follow-up on the same event.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects overlap/duplicate side-effect risk before enabling another Workflow and proposes consolidation or mutually exclusive conditions.

evals.prompt: Workflow is enabled but has zero executions.
evals.expected_output: The skill investigates event reachability/condition mismatch instead of assuming platform failure or configuration completeness.

evals.prompt: A Workflow validation passes but its Cadence was archived.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats downstream dependency readiness as required and does not call the Workflow production-ready.
